text:
[Act: limitation
 Chapter: First Division · Part IX · Suits Relating to Miscellaneous Matters
 Section: 112::Thirty years.
]


Any suit (except a suit before the Supreme Court in the exercise of its original jurisdiction) by or on behalf of the Central Government or any State Government, including the Government of the State of Jammu and Kashmir.
Period of limitationThirty years.
Time from which period begins to runWhen the period of limitation would begin to run under this Act against a like suit by a private person.
